name: Yong'an Bainian
source:
Players will enter a feudal dynasty with an elevated history from the perspective of "Bai Dixuan". From the birth of "Bai Dixuan" to his death, he has experienced how an aristocrat can realize his ideal and ambition in the face of disputes between the human state and the demon state.

Can players keep their original intention in the face of various temptations of fame and fortune? What is the secret behind the entanglement with the fate of the legendary "Li Changsheng"?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4145250/]Steam[/url]]
